_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); athletic footwear and apparel signals

pit_profile.why: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2014 10-K); the industry 'is highly competitive on a worldwide basis', 'including adidas, V.F. Corp., Puma, Li Ning, and Under Armour, among others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2014 10-K); the industry 'is highly competitive on a worldwide basis', 'including adidas, V.F. Corp., Puma, Li Ning, and Under Armour, among others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +89% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.32; conservative 2yr -16%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +15.0%/yr (Q3 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.0%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +15.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NKE (retrospective, 2015-05-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (48.4% downside to Bear $52 / +-3.8% upside to Bull $97) | Adj composite 2.48 vs market 3.80: gap -1.32 [OVERVALUED] | +89% above the EPP floor $53 (15x FY15E $3.56) | Conservative 2-yr case: -16.5% total (-8.3%/yr) | At 28.3x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $133 sits above the BULL case; futures orders +2.0% in Q3 FY15, forward revenues +13% (Q3 FY15 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
